column1: # comment: "logic:\u2194external correctness-corpus verdict bridge (by reference). The community-decided ground-truth vocabularies the external corpora carry \u2014 the W3C test-manifest entailment kinds (mf:PositiveEntailment/NegativeEntailment) and the OWL test ontology (otest:ConsistencyTest/InconsistencyTest) \u2014 are subsumed onto the logic:ConformanceVerdict lattice; each names a test whose expected outcome IS the verdict, hence skos:closeMatch. The alignment is BY REFERENCE (real W3C IRIs in full form; no axioms vendored). This is the ontological-use/dogfooding twin of the external FOL/DL soundness corpora (conformance/logic/cases/external/), which grade the native reasoner against these same ground-truth verdicts."

# # REFUSED (Principle 5 — no stable RDF namespace): the TPTP SZS result-status tokens (Theorem, Unsatisfiable, ContradictoryAxioms, Satisfiable, CounterSatisfiable, Unknown, GaveUp, Timeout, ResourceOut) publish no RDF/OWL namespace, so they are NOT aligned to fabricated per-token IRIs. They are subsumed instead as first-class logic:SzsStatus individuals (partitioned logic:SzsSuccess/SzsNoSuccess, ordered by logic:szsStrengthens) each carrying its verbatim token via logic:rawStatusToken, and the SZS→logic:ConformanceVerdict collapse is authored as the FnO function gmeow:fnSzsToVerdict (dsl/mappings/transforms.fno.ttl) — the declarative twin of the native crates/conformance status table. The lossy 3-bucket projection carries a logic:SoundUnderApproximation preservation claim.

# # NOTE (by reference, Principle 5): the W3C test-manifest and OWL-test vocabularies are W3C-Document-licensed; no imports/targets snapshot is committed because the alignment links real IRIs rather than vendoring axioms.

column7: The W3C «NegativeEntailment» test kind: the conclusion is NOT entailed. Its ground-truth outcome is logic:ConfConsistent (a counter-model exists). closeMatch — a test classification, not a verdict value.
The OWL «ConsistencyTest» test kind: the ontology is expected to be consistent. Its ground-truth outcome is logic:ConfConsistent. closeMatch — a test classification, not a verdict value.

The W3C «PositiveEntailment» test kind: the conclusion IS entailed by the premises. Its community-decided ground-truth outcome is logic:ConfInconsistent (the negated-conclusion reduction is unsatisfiable). closeMatch — a test classification, not a verdict value.
The OWL «InconsistencyTest» test kind: the ontology is expected to be inconsistent. Its ground-truth outcome is logic:ConfInconsistent. closeMatch — a test classification, not a verdict value.
